checks: Home and failed acquisition task navigate to the single settings session card; Home has no duplicate session polling
Desktop and 390px login/check/cancel/clear buttons work; POST bodies contain only an empty object
Active QR availability renders the same-origin PNG API with qr_updated_at in the URL; waiting for an unavailable QR remains explicit
The local contract PNG is decoded by the browser; no-store and two distinct image versions are verified; screenshot visibly says NOT A QR CODE
Image load failure is explicit and can reload; it never fabricates login success
Login success and cancellation remove the image; closed verification windows allow a new login
Explicit QR restart calls POST login, removes the old image, waits for a new QR, and uses its new version; GET status refresh is not labeled QR restart
Saved logged-in and expired sessions can explicitly POST check; headless checking has no QR-restart button and does not ask the user to scan
Session verification, saved session and video acquisition remain distinct; clear warns that an active acquisition stops but saved content remains
Polling waits 2.5 seconds after each read; slow reads never overlap; unmount stops reads and late response updates
Read failures retain previous state and qualify stale verification; operation failures do not automatically repeat login or invoke tasks/models
Desktop and 390px have no horizontal overflow; completed interaction flows have no uncaught browser exceptions
